name: eg-real-estate-tax
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Egyptian real estate taxes for tax year 2026, and keep the three apart. (1) The annual built real estate tax (الضريبة على العقارات المبنية) under Law 196 of 2008 as amended, administered by the Real Estate Tax Authority (مصلحة الضرائب العقارية) under the Ministry of Finance: 10% of the annual rental value after the 30% or 32% maintenance deduction, the EGP 100,000 private residence exemption and the 2026 filing discounts. (2) The 2.5% income tax on disposals of built property and building land, Law 91 of 2005 art. 42, collected by the Egyptian Tax Authority. (3) Income tax on rents. Trigger on "Egypt real estate tax", "ضريبة العقارات", "الضريبة العقارية", "annual rental value tax", "property tax Egypt", "2.5% property sale tax Egypt", "ضريبة التصرفات العقارية", or any property tax question for Egyptian owners or landlords.
